subject: Confirming billing contact & delivery route after AP migration
thread_body:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novacorp.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: AP migration & invoicing delivery

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note from NovaCorp AP — we are moving our accounts payable to HelixAP (go-live 2025-09-15) and would like to consolidate all Redwood invoices into a single monthly statement per legal entity. Can you confirm: 

- Who at Redwood should be the "Bill To" contact (name + email) for consolidated statements?
- Do you support direct delivery to HelixAP's vendor portal (we can provide the vendor ID), and do you require any onboarding XML schema or sample for e-invoice ingestion?
- VAT tagging: we need invoice lines to include the VAT registration id for EU entities and a reverse-charge flag where applicable.

Attached is our migration checklist for vendors to complete. Can we have the billing contact and preferred delivery route by end of this week?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Soto
Director, Accounts Payable
NovaCorp

---

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novacorp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AP migration & invoicing delivery

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for the checklist. Looping in Kimberly (Sales Ops) and Connor (AP onboarding) so we can land a plan that meets your go-live window.

Short answers to start:
- I can be the primary contact for coordination, but we usually delegate the actual invoice emission owner to our Billing Ops team (they handle the portal enrollments). For the single point of contact on your side, can you share the Helix vendor ID and whether you need monthly consolidated statements grouped by legal entity or by customer code?
- We do support portal delivery to many vendor portals and can push e-invoice XML/SFTP. If Helix provides an API endpoint or SFTP host, we can push a sample payload for you to validate.
- VAT tagging: we can include VAT reg ids per line and a reverse-charge indicator; we'll just need the mapping table from your side.

I attached a short intake template so Kimberly/Connor can see what we need. If possible, let's do a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize the vendor identifier and sample schema.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Customer Success – Invoicing & Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-invoice-intake-template.xlsx (stub)

---

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, Elena Soto <elena.soto@novacorp.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AP migration & invoicing delivery

Thanks Jasmine — quick operational notes from Sales Ops: 

Elena — welcome. A few pragmatic suggestions to reduce breakage during your HelixAP cutover: 

1) Delivery mode: portal-native delivery is preferable (fewer manual steps) but we recommend "portal-only" for the first full invoice cycle after go-live, with an email copy to ap@novacorp.com for two cycles only if you expect exceptions. After 60 days we can switch to portal-only automation.

2) Sample payload: attached is our portal_sample_xml_schema.xml we normally send to partners. If Helix has required fields beyond that (vendor ID, remit-to, legal entity tag), please flag them so we can produce a validated sample.

3) VAT & reverse-charge: to include the reverse-charge flag we need your country/entity mapping and the exact VAT reg numbers to sit in the invoice header and per-line (where applicable). We can accept a CSV mapping or a secure Drive share.

4) PO & remittance: please confirm whether your AP wants the PO number in the invoice header (recommended) and whether remittances should go to payments@novacorp.com or a remit ledger you provide.

If this looks good I can start the portal enrollment form and Connor can push a sample XML for validation.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: portal_sample_xml_schema.xml (stub)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abcd1234-onboarding

---

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, Elena Soto <elena.soto@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AP migration & invoicing delivery

Hi all — Connor here from Onboarding. Per Kim's note, I've prefilled our enrollment form and assigned a temporary billing emitter account for NovaCorp: bill-emitter-nvc-001@redwood.com.

Operational items I'm locking in today: 
- Billing owner for messages & enrollment: jasmine_liu@redwood.com (coordination)
- Invoice emitter (system account): bill-emitter-nvc-001@redwood.com (will sign the electronic invoice, send via portal or SFTP)
- Fallback path: push to your Helix SFTP host if portal fails; email PDF copy to ap@novacorp.com only for the first two cycles as Kim suggested.

I will send a sample XML payload within 2 business days to the Helix test endpoint you provide. Elena — can you confirm the vendor ID and the SFTP host (if portal-only is not available)? Also, we'll need a signed MOU for the portal integration (small legal appendix) — I can drop a DocuSign link once you confirm vendor-ID.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
AP Onboarding
Redwood Inference

---

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novacorp.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AP migration & invoicing delivery

Thanks — vendor ID is NOVA-7790. HelixAP portal is preferred; vendor-facing SFTP is available as a fallback: sftp.helixap.novacorp.com (user and key will be provided).

Please proceed with: 
- Portal enrollment using vendor ID NOVA-7790
- Sample XML to helix-test@helixap.novacorp.com (we'll share credentials)
- Add VAT registration id for NovaCorp EU entity (EU-VAT-998877) as header-level field; add reverse-charge flag on lines where tax = 0.

I can sign the integration MOU — DocuSign link would be great. Attaching our migration checklist and a PO example.

Best regards,
Elena Soto
Director, Accounts Payable
NovaCorp

Attachments: novacorp-ap-migration-checklist.pdf (stub), nova-po-sample.pdf (stub)
Link: https://docusign.com/ABC-12345
